item.text: The shared implementation is `packages/ai/src/utils/idle-iterator.ts`: both the standalone first-event watchdog and the per-iteration idle/first-event timer pass raw values to `setTimeout`. I’m fixing both paths together so oversized values behave consistently, including values used as “effectively never.”

The implementation now clamps every watchdog delay at `2_147_483_647` ms, while preserving disabled (`0`/non-positive) behavior. I added a focused regression assertion for the standalone watchdog and a package changelog fragment. Next I’m running the targeted test and type/lint validation.
